from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ArvanaShareCapitalRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single share capital data point extracted from one filing."""
    company: Literal["Arvana Inc"] = Field(description="The company name, as named in the task")
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers")
    shares_outstanding: str = Field(description="The number of shares outstanding, as written in the document")
    split_adjustment_status: str = Field(description="Description of any stock split adjustments applied (e.g., 'pre-split', 'retroactively adjusted', 'post-split')")
    measurement_date: str = Field(description="The specific date the share count applies to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_capital_records: list[ArvanaShareCapitalRecord]
